description: Scrapes comments from any TikTok video using apidojo's TikTok Comments scraper on Apify. Triggers when the user asks to: get all comments on a TikTok video, export TikTok comment data, scrape what viewers are saying on a TikTok post, fetch comment text and likes from a TikTok URL, collect TikTok comment threads for analysis, or download comments from a viral TikTok video. Returns commenter username, comment text, like count, reply count, and timestamp per comment. Ideal for sentiment analysts, brand monitors, and content researchers.
